newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BNP says to buy broking, finance arms of PrimeEast.
newsitem.headline: BNP says to buy broking, finance arms of PrimeEast.

text.p: Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement to acquire the stockbroking and corporate finance businesses of PrimeEast Capital Group for an undisclosed amount.

In a statement, the French bank said it had incorporated a new company called BNP-PrimeEast in association with Prime Partners, a collective of PrimeEast Capital Group founders Ng Soo Peng, Hsieh Fu Hua, Teo Ek Tor and Quek Peck Lim.
BNP will hold 70 percent of the new venture and Prime Partners the remaining 30 percent, it said.
BNP-PrimeEast will acquire the stockbroking, equity research and distribution, and corporate finance businesses of PrimeEast Capital Group, BNP said.
PrimeEast Capital Group is owned 35 percent by Bank of East Asia, 35 percent by ECICS Property Ltd and the remainder by the four founders.
The deal also includes the acquisition of a 35 percent stake in Belson-PrimeEast Capital Asia, an investment house in the Philippines currently held by PrimeEast, BNP said.
BNP-PrimeEast has a staff of about 100 and operations in Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and New York, it said.
BNP did not disclose the purchase price or give any figures of capital to be injected into the venture.
